extracted.name: Doggie ice cream
extracted.description: Make this easy treat to keep your pooch cool on a hot day. It's made using just three ingredients – banana, peanut butter and natural yogurt
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp natural peanut butter (ensure it's xylitol-free as this is toxic for dogs)
instruction_lines: Mash the banana in a bowl using a fork until it's a purée consistency. Mix in the peanut butter and yogurt until well combined.
Transfer to an ice cube tray (we used a fun silicone mould with dog-themed shapes) and freeze for at least 2 hrs. Will keep frozen for up to six months.
